description: Figure 2 is a circular, multi-layered diagram illustrating the composition of the MULTITURNINSTRUCT benchmark. The outer ring is divided into nine colored segments, each representing a distinct capability: Prioritization (red, 100 samples), Personalization (orange-red, 100), Privacy Protection (red-orange, 111), Multitasking (green, 160), Context Retrieving (teal, central inner segment), Context Tracking (dark teal, central inner segment), Contradiction Resolution (maroon, central inner segment), Dynamic Instruction (light cyan, 100), Memorization (light green, 100), Dynamic Environment (blue, 100), Recursive Reasoning (bright blue, 110), and Triggering (light blue, 100). The innermost circle is segmented into three overlapping categories — Context Retrieving, Context Tracking, and Contradiction Resolution — suggesting these are core or foundational capabilities. Each outer segment is labeled with its name and the number of samples allocated to it, visually indicating the distribution of tasks across the nine capabilities, which collectively total approximately 1.1K samples as stated in the caption. The diagram uses color-coding and radial layout to convey the structure and relative weighting of the benchmark’s components.
